verdict.rationale: Stripe's testing docs confirm that in test mode the authentication flow shows only Stripe-managed test institutions, and accounts can be linked from them without credentials. That covers the core sandbox-linking part of the story. The pack does not show that test-mode accounts return balance, ownership or transaction data, or that specific test institutions simulate failures or error states. missing for 10: documented test-mode data retrieval, simulated error and failure scenarios, documented test credentials or test-case catalogue, independent hands-on corroboration.
